study_role: exploratory mechanism redesign after the registered spatial-window oracle failed liveness

unchanged_clean_reference.reuse_rationale: The frozen planner, route, sensors, and clean inputs are unchanged; the new schedule is inactive when corruption is empty.

termination.coordinate: simulation time since first onset frame

duration_selection_disclosure: In the completed spatial-window corrupted-off run, corruption began at 9.85 s and the pedestrian collision location was reached at 14.05 s, a 4.20 s exposure. Five seconds is the next whole-second duration and covers that known failure with a 0.80 s margin. Because this value uses an observed outcome, this pair is explicitly exploratory and requires a later held-out confirmation before a paper-level confirmatory claim.
execution_gate: Run oracle only if transient-off is an eligible completion with worse safety than the unchanged clean reference.

oracle.controller: the existing bounded UQRiskGovernor without parameter changes

success_criteria.transient_off: eligible terminal record, 100% completion, and at least one collision or a lower official safety score than clean
success_criteria.transient_oracle: eligible terminal record, 100% completion, zero collisions, no blocked or timeout infraction, and a strictly higher composed score than transient-off

uniform_termination_rules.low_speed_fast_screen: cancel and mark diagnostic-only if absolute ego speed remains below 0.25 m/s for at least 8 consecutive simulation seconds
uniform_termination_rules.runtime_no_progress: cancel and mark environment-error if both trace and agent log remain unchanged for at least 8 wall-clock minutes
